title: /billing-plans loads for an org owner with no console/network errors
preconditions: Org has a configured SubscriptionInstance (V2 ledger)
steps: Confirm both Overview and Plans tabs render
expectedResult: Page loads within a reasonable time, both tabs are visible/clickable, and no unhandled request failures appear in the network panel.

title: GET /api/v1/subscriptions/current returns 200 (or a clean 404) for an active org
steps: Call GET /api/v1/subscriptions/current with a valid billing.read JWT
expectedResult: 200 response with the org's current plan/tier/entitlements fields populated (or 404 SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_CONFIGURED for a brand-new org, which is also a healthy non-500 response).

title: GET /v1/billing/invoices returns 200 (even if empty) for an active org
steps: Call GET /v1/billing/invoices with a valid billing.read JWT
expectedResult: 200 response with the paginated invoice shape, whether or not any invoices exist yet.
description: Superseded by the 2026-08-04 billing rewrite — GET /v1/billing/invoices no longer exists; there is no invoice-history endpoint anywhere in the current codebase to smoke-test.

title: POST /webhooks/stripe is reachable and correctly rejects a request with no stripe-signature header
steps: Call POST /webhooks/stripe with a minimal JSON body and no stripe-signature header
expectedResult: Endpoint responds 400 'Invalid signature' (proves the route is mounted and the signature check is live) rather than timing out, 404ing, or 500ing.
description: Superseded by the 2026-08-04 billing rewrite — POST /webhooks/stripe no longer exists; there is no webhook route to smoke-test.

title: Public subscription-plans endpoint returns at least one public plan
expectedResult: 200 response listing one or more plans with isPublic=true, each with tierCode/label/pricePerFrameworkAnnualCents/limits/entitlements populated (customer.controller.js's PUBLIC_PLAN_FIELDS projection) — the Plans tab and vibrantix-website have data to render.

title: GET /api/public/subscription-plans is reachable without auth and returns at least one plan
steps: Call GET /api/public/subscription-plans with no Authorization header and no CORS-restricted origin
expectedResult: 200 { plans:[...] } with at least one entry where isPublic=true and scope='organization' — the vibrantix-website plan comparison page and any unauthenticated plan browsing has data to render.

title: GET /api/v1/subscriptions/current never 500s — returns 200 with a plan, or a clean 404 SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_CONFIGURED
preconditions: Valid billing.read JWT for any org, configured or not
expectedResult: Either 200 with populated plan/entitlements fields, or 404 { error:{code:'SUBSCRIPTION_NOT_CONFIGURED'} } for a brand-new org — never a 5xx.
